entries.back_en: "You not only infiltrated the Empire--with whom we have a truce, let me clarify--but were caught in the act and deported. I ask you, is this conduct worthy of a warrior, someone who calls himself leader of the mighty Woren nation!?"
entries.note: 'I might add' rendered as 'let me clarify'; minor nuance shift, acceptable.

entries.back_en: "Do you have any idea what your reckless, thoughtless acts will cost us and the whole Alliance in negotiations with the Empire? Do you!?"
"But how can you just sit there like that, when a member of one of the Alliance's royal families... When Elina has been kidnapped by the Empire!?"
"[name]! Can't you keep an eye on them!? You let them go off and make a fake sword like that... What were you thinking!?"
"Master [name] is the leader of the Woren nation... Unlike you, he must be kept under strict guard."
"I'm sorry, I cannot allow passage." "The inquiry into Chief [name]'s actions may take several days. You should wait in your room in the city."
"I just can't understand what they're thinking! I mean, after all, the prince's fiancee is missing, right? How can he just sit there like that?"
Defeat the Guards! You only have 1 turn before the guards call for reinforcements! Use combo attacks to defeat them quickly!
"Looks like some Alliance members are quarreling... If a war starts now, we might be in trouble."

entries.note: 'Yikes' (exclamation of fright) rendered as 'ajuda' (help), shifting meaning and duplicating later 'Socorro'.

entries.back_en: "Aren't you going to try and stop us, [name]?"
